name: Scope
description: SCOPE (Simulating Cross-game Operations in Playable Environments) is an interactive real-time FPS world model developed by University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS). It incorporates a Spatial Action Decoupling module into video diffusion transformer blocks (Wan2.2) to achieve per-pixel temporal action conditioning, separating localized weapon/HUD effects from global environment rendering.
keyFeatures: Spatial Action Decoupling Module for per-pixel temporal action conditioning without segmentation labels
10-DoF Hybrid Action Space supporting 4 continuous control axes and 6 binary action buttons
CrossFPS Dataset comprising 69,000+ clips across 7 game titles with frame-aligned telemetry
Zero-shot cross-game transfer to unseen FPS environments without fine-tuning
High spatial stability eliminating global screen jitter during high-frequency action execution
institution: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS)
curatorNotes: Verified paper arXiv:2605.23345 and open-source release from University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS).
